map_wrapper.notes: wraps narduk-mapkit-nuxt's AppMapKit (line 291) -- this is the one lane repo that has actually adopted the shared map component.
largest component in the repo, a 3D globe view (not built on AppMapKit -- distinct rendering mode from RouteMap).
fallback when globe/map rendering is unavailable.
visual pulse/animation overlay on the route map.

timeline_feed.notes: live hop-by-hop feed (aria-live='polite'), one article per network hop with index/IP/geo/RTT columns-as-rows. Has its OWN inline empty state ('Start a trace to watch routers resolve in real time') and its own loading indicator ('Discovering next hop', role='status') rather than using a shared component for either -- both are candidates for empty_state/loading_skeleton extraction even though narduk-libs' pattern list wasn't the natural home for this component's primary job.

other.notes: trace playback scrubber/controls, domain-specific, not a lane-target pattern.

defect_history.summary: wrangler config lacks no_bundle/find_additional_modules; production 404 page server-renders empty

top_extraction_candidates.name: AppMapKit adoption (RouteMap.client.vue)
top_extraction_candidates.why: Not a hand-rolled duplicate -- the opposite finding: this is proof narduk-mapkit-nuxt's AppMapKit is usable in a real, demanding client-only map product. Worth citing as a positive-adoption reference rather than an extraction target.

top_extraction_candidates.name: HopTimeline
top_extraction_candidates.why: Small, clean live-feed pattern (aria-live, own empty+loading inline states) that could generalize to any real-time event/log feed elsewhere in the estate, though only 1 consumer here so reuse pressure is unproven.

notes: Single-page app (app/pages/index.vue only); every component in app/components has exactly 1 consumer because there is only one page -- consumer counts here measure usage sites, not cross-page reuse. No table, no pagination, no server-side list API (server/api/trace.post.ts is a POST action endpoint, not a list GET). This is the one repo in the lane that already depends on and uses narduk-mapkit-nuxt's AppMapKit, which is a useful positive data point for narduk-libs adoption viability. No table/mobile UI defects in issue or PR history; only 1 open PR (a routine wrangler dependency bump) and one closed empty-page infra issue (#14, same class of wrangler-bundling bug reported independently in hydrogen #54 -- possibly a recurring estate-wide wrangler config gotcha worth flagging to the orchestrator).
